name: Gemini 3.8 Live
access: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Live API; generally available 2026-09-24)
Partner platforms that call the Live API (listed on Google's Live API page: LiveKit, Pipecat, Agora and others)

output: text (a transcript of the audio; the response modality must be audio)
video (Live Avatar, Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform)

voice.input_audio: Raw 16-bit PCM, little-endian, mono. 16 kHz is native. Other rates are resampled when the MIME type states the rate, for example audio/pcm;rate=16000. Images and video go in as JPEG frames, at most 1 frame a second [gemini-live-capabilities, gemini-live-overview]
voice.output_audio: Raw 16-bit PCM, little-endian, mono, 24 kHz. Google marks generated audio with a SynthID watermark [gemini-live-capabilities, gemini-cloud-live-guide, google-3-8-live-blog, google-cloud-live-avatar-blog]
voice.voices: Prebuilt voices shared with Google's text-to-speech models; the Live pages name Kore and Aoede as examples and do not give a count for the Live API. The set differs slightly from the voices of generateContent [gemini-live-capabilities]
languages: Automatic detection and switching during a conversation. Google gives four different counts: 97 (launch post and Cloud blog), 99 (capabilities guide, with BCP-47 codes), 70 (Live API overview) and 24 (Enterprise Agent Platform overview) [google-3-8-live-blog, google-cloud-live-avatar-blog, gemini-live-capabilities, gemini-live-overview, gemini-cloud-live-overview]
voice.turn_detection: Server-side voice activity detection is on by default (realtimeInputConfig.automaticActivityDetection). Settings: start_of_speech_sensitivity, end_of_speech_sensitivity, prefix_padding_ms and silence_duration_ms. The server default for silence is about 800 ms, and Google advises 500 to 800 ms [gemini-live-capabilities]. Automatic detection can be turned off (disabled: true). The client then sends activityStart and activityEnd, and Google advises a client silence threshold of at least 500 ms. A hybrid mode keeps server detection for the start of speech and lets a client detector send audio_stream_end for a fast end of turn [gemini-live-capabilities]. The client sends audioStreamEnd when the microphone pauses for more than one second [gemini-live-capabilities].
voice.interruption: Barge-in is supported. When detection hears the user during output, the server cancels the generation, discards pending function calls and sends interrupted: true. The client must drop its queued playback audio at once [gemini-live-capabilities, gemini-live-best-practices]. On Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform a tool response sent with INTERRUPT is downgraded to WHEN_IDLE while the user is speaking [gemini-cloud-live-guide].
voice.latency: 1.18 seconds average time to first audio on Artificial Analysis's Big Bench Audio set [aa-speech-to-speech]. Google publishes no figure.
voice.session_limit: Without context window compression an audio-only session ends after 15 minutes and an audio-plus-video session after 2 minutes. With compression and session resumption a session can run without a time limit. One connection lasts about 10 minutes, and the server sends GoAway before it closes the connection. Resumption handles stay valid for 2 hours after the session ends. The session context window is 128k tokens [gemini-live-capabilities, gemini-live-session]. On Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform the limit is 1,000 concurrent sessions per project on pay-as-you-go, and GoAway comes 60 seconds before the end [gemini-cloud-live-session].

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Gemini API pricing page, paid plan, standard rate. Input: text $0.75, audio $3.00 (about $0.005 a minute), image or video $1.00 (about $0.002 a minute). Output: text $4.50, audio $12.00 (about $0.018 a minute), and the output price includes thinking tokens. The input and output fields of this card hold the audio rates. Audio counts 25 tokens a second [gemini-live-best-practices]. Each turn bills the whole session context again, so the cost of a turn grows with session length [gemini-live-best-practices]. Turning on audio transcription adds text output tokens at the text rate. Search grounding: 5,000 free requests a month shared across Gemini 3.x models, then $14 per 1,000 requests. The free plan costs nothing and Google may use its data to improve products; the paid plan is not used for that. One table covers gemini-3.8-live, gemini-3.8-live-extended-thinking and gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview [gemini-pricing]. No caching, no batch. The Enterprise Agent Platform page lists Provisioned Throughput and standard pay-as-you-go, and not Priority [gemini-cloud-3-8-live, gemini-cloud-live-troubleshooting].

status: the Gemini API changelog calls the model generally available on 2026-09-15 and its deprecations page lists no shutdown date, but the Live API capabilities guide and best-practices page still carry a banner that says the Live API is in preview
released: 2026-09-15 is the Gemini API date; Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform release notes give 2026-09-24 for general availability there
context_window: the model page says 131,072 input tokens and the model card says 128K; 131,072 kept. The session context window is 128k tokens

reasoning: the Gemini API page says interleaved reasoning with thinkingLevel not supported, so no control exists; 'always-on' records that wording. The Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform model page lists thinking as not supported

modalities: the model page lists text output, the guides say the response modality must be audio and that text comes from output transcription; video output (Live Avatar) is listed only on Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform
voice.voices: no count of voices for the Live API found; the 3.8 Flash TTS guide lists 30 prebuilt voices and says the Live set differs slightly from generateContent
voice.languages: Google's pages give 97, 99, 70 and 24 languages; no page says which count applies to this model on which surface
voice.latency: Google publishes no latency figure; the figure recorded is a measurer's, from a text-free benchmark set

benchmarks: Google's evaluation file shows its results as chart images. The EVA-Bench chart is a scatter plot with no data labels, the Sierra tau3-Banking chart does not include this model, and the Artificial Analysis charts repeat the leaderboard. The file says Artificial Analysis ran the model under the id gemini-3.8-live-preview
access: Google's launch post says Gemini Enterprise was in private preview on 2026-09-15; the Cloud blog of 2026-09-25 says Live Avatar is generally available there
